tasks.title: Rust: anti-aliased path rasterizer — AA cell grid, stroke joins/dashes, clip stack (Phase C, sev3 canv)
tasks.description: PORT-PLAN Phase 2 item 3 (Rasterization quality, Phase C). The engine-internals sev3 rows 'aggregated zerox agg-2.4/include' and 'graphics/Image.cpp|Image.h' map to wo-renderer::canvas. Current canvas.rs strokes single-pixel perpendicular quads with hard edges (no AA), no joins/dashes, clip() is a coarse bbox flag. Implement an aggregate-style anti-aliased rasterizer: (1) an AA cell coverage buffer (render flat-filled paths with per-cell coverage from PathBuilder::flatten), (2) stroke with miter/round joins + dash pattern on the flattened segments, (3) a real clip stack (push/pop intersects current path with the coverage mask). Keep the public Canvas API and wasm bridge untouched. Add raster_tests.rs: AA diagonal line has 2+ shades (not all-or-nothing), round join on a 90-degree corner fills the outer corner, dashed line = alternating on/off runs, clip restricts drawn pixels to intersection, no wasm signature change. Do NOT edit wo-renderer-wasm. Baseline: `cargo test -p wo-renderer --lib` = 138 passing; keep them green.

tasks.title: Rust: antialiased image interpolation — bilinear Image::draw_image scaling + transparent blend (Phase C sev3 Image)
tasks.description: PORT-PLAN Phase 2 item 3 tail. engine-internals sev3 rows wo-renderer::canvas <- graphics/Image.cpp|Image.h. P2-01 added Canvas::draw_image but it uses nearest-neighbor sampling (aliased) and ignores per-pixel alpha. Upgrade draw_image to bilinear interpolation for scaling + proper src-over alpha blending (use wo-raster's Pixel::blend_over / RasterImage if convenient). Keep the existing signature. Extend raster_tests.rs (or image tests) with: bilinear upscale of a 2x2 gradient is smooth (no hard block edges), a fully-transparent source pixel contributes nothing, 50%-alpha red over blue ground = purple-ish. Baseline: `cargo test -p wo-renderer --lib` = 138 (+R01); keep green. Do NOT edit wo-renderer-wasm or wo-ooxml.
